plainTranslation: The Mars person's drive meets Pluto's power. This can become passion, ambition, and fearless action, or a battle for dominance. If conflict becomes the engine of attraction, slow the whole thing down.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper press against your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The harder part is what this becomes when it goes unchecked, and it can go to dark places. You may push each other's buttons until the smallest thing detonates, get trapped in a cycle of rupture and reconnection that feels like passion but functions like a hook, and find that the connection brings out things in you, and in them, that frighten you. The intensity can stop feeling like chemistry and start feeling like something you cannot get out from under. This is the contact where people stay long past the point it is good for them, telling themselves the depth of the pull must mean something, while the connection slowly takes more than it gives.
advice: So watch the pattern, not just the pull. Notice whether you leave feeling stronger or smaller, steadier or more afraid. Notice whether the fights ever resolve or only reset. Notice whether you have stopped telling the people who love you what actually happens between you, or whether you would be ashamed to say it out loud. If you find yourself making excuses for how this person treats you, hiding the worst of it, or feeling like you cannot leave even though part of you wants to, listen to that. A powerful pull is never proof a connection is meant to be, and it is never a reason to stay somewhere that is harming you. If you are afraid, that fear is information, and you deserve to be safe more than you need to understand the connection.
summaryShort: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper press against your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed.
